import re, numpy as np
sections=re.split(r'Demo pair 1 (?:input|output) \(\d+x\d+\):\n', text)
print(len(sections),[len(x) for x in sections])
rows=[]
for s in sections[1:]:
 block=s.split('\n\n',1)[0]
 arr=np.array([[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in block.strip().splitlines()])
 rows.append(arr)
A,B=rows
print(A.shape,B.shape)
# split input halves by separator
sep=np.where(np.all(A==9,axis=1))[0][0]
T=A[:sep]; L=A[sep+1:]
print(T.shape,L.shape)
